name: Cauliflower, Quinoa & Chickpea Salad with Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
708 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry cauliflower and mushrooms. Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets and transfer to a sheet pan. Quarter the mushrooms and add to pan.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium heads cauliflower
0.341 kg white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle cauliflower and mushrooms with oil and season with thyme, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until tender, about 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing and toss to coat.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to bowl.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add quinoa, cauliflower, and mushrooms to bowl and toss.
To serve, place salad on a plate or in a bowl. Enjoy!
